tagline.en: El Camino Real, the Redwood Highway, the Pacific shore
tagline.zh: 王家大道、红木公路与太平洋岸

start.en: The East Los Angeles Interchange, where I-5, I-10 and SR 60 meet
start.zh: 东洛杉矶枢纽，I-5、I-10 与 SR 60 交会处

end.en: Interstate 5 at Tumwater, Washington, just south of Olympia
end.zh: 华盛顿州塔姆沃特，奥林匹亚以南，与 I-5 相接

en: US 101 is three roads sharing a number. South of San Francisco it is a busy urban and agricultural freeway — the Ventura and Bayshore freeways, the Santa Clara and Salinas valleys — laid over the line of El Camino Real, the road that linked the Spanish missions. North of the Golden Gate it becomes the Redwood Highway, narrowing to a two-lane road through Humboldt and Del Norte counties, where in places it runs between trees older than the mission chain. In Oregon and Washington it is the coast road, staying within sight of the Pacific for hundreds of miles while the through traffic uses I-5 inland.

Its final act is the strangest. Rather than end at the ocean, US 101 turns inland at Aberdeen and loops entirely around the Olympic Peninsula before doubling back south to Olympia, so that the road heads north, then west, then south under the same number. Signing follows suit: from Olympia it is posted north to Discovery Bay, west from there to Sappho, and south from there through Aberdeen and on into Oregon. The route ended in downtown Olympia until 1958; its terminus now is the interchange with I-5 at Tumwater.
zh: US 101 是共用一个号码的三条路。旧金山以南，它是一条繁忙的城市与农业高速公路——文图拉高速与贝肖尔高速、圣克拉拉谷与萨利纳斯谷——铺在王家大道的线位之上，那是当年串联西班牙传教站的道路。金门以北，它变成红木公路，在洪堡与德尔诺特两县收窄为双车道，有些地段两旁的树木比那串传教站还要古老。在俄勒冈与华盛顿，它是滨海公路，数百英里始终不离太平洋的视野，而过境车流则走内陆的 I-5。
它的收尾最为古怪。US 101 并不在海边结束，而是在阿伯丁转向内陆，绕奥林匹克半岛整整一圈，再折返南下至奥林匹亚，于是同一个号码之下，道路先北行、再西行、最后南行。标志也随之而变：自奥林匹亚起标为北行至发现湾，由此向西至萨福，再由此向南经阿伯丁进入俄勒冈。本路线原本终止于奥林匹亚市中心，直到 1958 年；如今的终点是塔姆沃特与 I-5 的互通。

en: US 101 was one of the original 1926 routes, and it inherited roads with much older identities: El Camino Real in California, and in the north the Redwood Highway, promoted from 1923 by an association formed in San Francisco to bring tourists to the towns among the big trees. As first commissioned it ran from the Mexican border at San Ysidro, then a separate town south of San Diego, all the way to Olympia — something over 1,600 miles.

California then spent four decades rebuilding it and finally cut it in half. Freeway bypasses replaced the surface road from the 1930s on; the Bayshore Freeway between San Jose and San Francisco, built to replace a two-lane highway so notorious for head-on collisions that it was called the Bloody Bayshore, opened in stages between 1947 and 1962. In the statewide renumbering that took effect on 1 July 1964, the state's policy was to drop U.S. numbers where an Interstate existed: I-5 took over the entire stretch from Los Angeles to the Mexican border, US 101 was cut back to the East Los Angeles Interchange, and the bypassed El Camino Real became State Route 82. Some of the abandoned southern sections were later signed by local governments as Historic US 101.
zh: US 101 是 1926 年最初那批路线之一，它所承袭的道路有着更古老的身份：在加利福尼亚是王家大道，在北部则是红木公路——后者自 1923 年起由一个在旧金山成立的协会推广，意在把游客带到巨树之间的小镇。它最初编定时自圣伊西德罗的墨西哥边境起（当时那是圣迭戈以南的一个独立城镇），一直通到奥林匹亚，全长一千六百余英里。

随后加利福尼亚花了四十年重建它，最终又把它砍掉一半。自 1930 年代起，高速公路绕行线不断取代原有的地面道路；圣何塞至旧金山之间的贝肖尔高速公路，是为取代一条因正面碰撞频发而被称作「血腥贝肖尔」的双车道公路而建，1947 至 1962 年间分段通车。在 1964 年 7 月 1 日生效的全州重新编号中，该州的方针是凡有州际公路者即取消美国国道编号：I-5 接管了洛杉矶至墨西哥边境的整段路线，US 101 被收缩至东洛杉矶枢纽，被绕开的王家大道则改编为 82 号州道。南段被放弃的部分路段，后来由地方政府标示为「历史 US 101」。

en: The most closely watched current project on US 101 does not carry a single car. At Liberty Canyon in Agoura Hills, where the freeway separates the Santa Monica Mountains from open land to the north, Caltrans and the National Wildlife Federation are building the Wallis Annenberg Wildlife Crossing, a vegetated bridge over ten lanes of traffic, paid for with a mix of state and federal transportation funds and private donations.

It has also become a case study in cost escalation. Caltrans lists the programmed project cost at about $92 million; the figure quoted for the whole effort, including design, studies and the second stage over Agoura Road, is now about $114 million, against roughly $90 million when work began in 2022. Project staff attribute the increase to near-record rainfall in 2023 and 2024, inflation, labour shortages and the difficulty of the work itself. The first stage, the bridge over the freeway, was finished in June 2025, and the crossing is scheduled to open on 2 December 2026.
zh: US 101 上目前最受关注的工程不通行任何汽车。在阿古拉希尔斯的自由峡谷，高速公路把圣莫尼卡山与北面的开阔土地隔开；加州交通部与国家野生动物联合会正在那里建造沃利斯·安嫩伯格野生动物通道，这是一座跨越十条车道的植被桥，资金来自州与联邦交通经费以及私人捐赠的组合。

它也成了造价攀升的一个案例。加州交通部列出的项目编列造价约为 9,200 万美元；而就整项工作、包括设计、研究与跨越阿古拉路的第二期而言，目前引用的数字约为 1.14 亿美元，而 2022 年开工时约为 9,000 万美元。项目人员把增幅归因于 2023 与 2024 年接近纪录的降雨、通胀、劳动力短缺以及工程本身的难度。第一期、即跨越高速公路的桥梁已于 2025 年 6 月完工，整座通道计划于 2026 年 12 月 2 日开放。

label.zh: 沃利斯·安嫩伯格野生动物通道

value.en: About $92 million in programmed project cost; roughly $114 million quoted for the whole effort, up from about $90 million at groundbreaking in 2022, funded by public transportation money, grants and private donations
value.zh: 项目编列造价约 9,200 万美元；整项工作引用的数字约为 1.14 亿美元，而 2022 年动工时约为 9,000 万美元；资金来自公共交通经费、拨款与私人捐赠

figures.source: Caltrans District 7 project page; Ventura County Star, August 2026

why.en: No such figure exists. US 101 was numbered in 1926 over roads California, Oregon and Washington had already built, and was then rebuilt piecemeal over sixty years of separately funded freeway and bypass projects.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。US 101 于 1926 年沿加利福尼亚、俄勒冈与华盛顿三州已建成的道路编号，此后六十年间又通过分别筹资的高速公路与绕行线项目逐段重建。

why.en: No current authoritative figure: AASHTO leaves U.S. Route mileage to the states and has published no national log since 1989. An endpoint survey puts the pre-1964 route at about 1,653 miles, before I-5 took over everything south of Los Angeles.
why.zh: 目前没有权威数字：AASHTO 把美国国道里程交由各州统计，1989 年后未再发布全国里程表。一项端点调查认为 1964 年之前的路线约长 1,653 英里，那时 I-5 尚未接管洛杉矶以南的全部路段。

why.en: Three state agencies count their own segments, and the range is enormous: a ten-lane urban freeway in Los Angeles, a two-lane road through the redwoods, a lightly used coast road on the Olympic Peninsula. No combined figure is published.
why.zh: 3 个州的机构各自统计本州路段，且差异极大：在洛杉矶是十车道城市高速路，在红木林中是双车道公路，在奥林匹克半岛则是车流稀少的滨海道路。并无合并数字发布。

why.en: Condition data are reported to the Federal Highway Administration by state and functional class rather than by U.S. Route number, so no route-level rating exists for US 101.
why.zh: 路况数据按州与功能等级、而非按美国国道编号上报联邦公路管理局，因此不存在针对 US 101 的全线评级。

timeline.en: The Redwood Highway Association is formed in San Francisco to promote the northern California section to tourists.
timeline.zh: 红木公路协会在旧金山成立，向游客推广加利福尼亚北段。

timeline.en: US 101 is commissioned from the Mexican border at San Ysidro to Olympia, Washington.
timeline.zh: US 101 编定，自圣伊西德罗的墨西哥边境至华盛顿州奥林匹亚。

timeline.en: The northern terminus moves out of downtown Olympia.
timeline.zh: 北端终点迁出奥林匹亚市中心。

timeline.en: The Bayshore Freeway between San Jose and San Francisco is completed after fifteen years of staged openings.
timeline.zh: 圣何塞至旧金山的贝肖尔高速公路在分段通车十五年后全线建成。

timeline.en: California's renumbering takes effect: I-5 replaces US 101 from Los Angeles to the Mexican border and the route is cut back to the East Los Angeles Interchange.
timeline.zh: 加利福尼亚的重新编号生效：I-5 取代洛杉矶至墨西哥边境的 US 101，本路线被收缩至东洛杉矶枢纽。

timeline.en: Construction begins on the Wallis Annenberg Wildlife Crossing over the freeway at Liberty Canyon.
timeline.zh: 自由峡谷跨越高速公路的沃利斯·安嫩伯格野生动物通道开工。
